architecture: ImageNet MobileNetV3 Small frozen 576-dimensional features + trained logistic head
preprocessing: App JPEG normalization; IMAGENET1K_V1 resize 256 / center crop 224 / ImageNet normalization

evaluation.split_method: StratifiedGroupKFold; seed 42 outer test, seed 43 inner validation; no similarity group shared.
evaluation.label_source: User dataset folder names; clinical provenance unverified.
limitations: No patient IDs: similarity grouping cannot guarantee patient separation.
No TSB/TcB measurements: cannot estimate bilirubin or grade severity.
Class score is not calibrated clinical confidence.
No external or prospective clinical validation.
Hospital backgrounds, devices, lighting and skin tone may confound results.
